scope.e2_exclusion_reason: compatibility trajectory collected outside the preregistered E2 population

route_reproduction.method: replay the seeded generator to the selected candidate index; the generator replayed is the one the population was evaluated with

kinematic_drive.guard: PhysX overlap against scene collision geometry, robot self-hits excluded

thresholds.label: PREDECLARED COLLECTION ADEQUACY THRESHOLDS
thresholds.not_defined_by: elapsed wall-clock seconds; nor by any published model requirement

detail.threshold_semantics: PREDECLARED COLLECTION ADEQUACY THRESHOLDS -- frozen before any candidate route was evaluated; not requirements published by GNM, ViNT or NoMaD
detail.window_derivation: TrajectorySpec.num_samples, mirroring ViNT_Dataset._build_index at the pinned upstream commit; GNM/ViNT context_size 5, NoMaD context_size 3 with len_traj_pred 8
detail.no_rounding: values are compared as measured; nothing is rounded into a pass

G8_controller_identity.reason: controller identity unchanged across the episode

detail.claim_boundary: controller identity only. This gate does not establish that the robot moved: a command issued to a wedged articulation produces an identical digest. Realised motion is a postcondition measured from recorded poses.

G9_goal_image_seal.reason: goal declared, captured, hashed, sealed, then motion began

detail.provenance_is_the_event_order: pixel similarity does not establish provenance in either direction: a stationary robot photographs the same scene twice, and two different images do not show which was captured first

detail.distinct_from_g8: G8 proves the controller did not change; this proves the base moved

episode_did_not_reach_its_goal.status_under_the_frozen_contract: ADMITTED. `reached_goal` is not among the frozen post-episode conditions, which are the six adequacy thresholds plus data integrity. The trajectory is admitted because it meets what was frozen, not because reaching the goal was checked and passed.
episode_did_not_reach_its_goal.why_it_is_reported_prominently: the trajectory is an INCOMPLETE traversal of its route. A reader assuming an admitted trajectory ran start-to-goal would be wrong, and nothing in the six thresholds would tell them.
episode_did_not_reach_its_goal.consequence_for_the_goal_image: G9 sealed the view AT the intended goal, which the robot never reached. That is coherent for image-goal navigation, where the goal is a target rather than a guaranteed endpoint, but it means the final observation and the goal image are 1.679 m apart rather than nearly coincident.

realised_turns_are_amplified_not_attenua.observation: realised turns are roughly 1.8-2.6x the planned magnitudes, the opposite direction from the controller fixtures where 90 degrees realised as 65. Combined with 25.707 m realised against 23.252 m planned and termination on max_steps, this is consistent with overshoot and circling near the end of the route rather than clean tracking.
realised_turns_are_amplified_not_attenua.not_claimed: no cause is asserted. This is a descriptive observation from one trajectory, and the controller fixtures measured the opposite behaviour on analytic geometry.
realised_turns_are_amplified_not_attenua.does_not_invalidate_admission: the frozen contract requires >= 3 distinct realised events of >= 30 degrees. Larger events satisfy it. Nothing in the contract caps a turn.

ADMISSION_CAVEATS.what_is_established: a real Hospital trajectory exists with 1200 frames, 1200 matching images, finite poses, three distinct realised turn events, 1189 NoMaD windows, an unchanged controller identity, a sealed pre-motion goal image distinct from the final observation, and zero collision-guard rejections.
what_is_NOT_established: any drivetrain, contact or slip fidelity
that this trajectory is adequate training data -- one trajectory establishes format compatibility, not dataset quality
